name: System Party Identification 11
definition: Unique and unambiguous identification of a party within a system.

Name.name: Name
Name.definition: Name by which a party is known and which is usually used to identify that party.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Unique identification to unambiguously identify the party within the system.

ResponsiblePartyIdentification.name: Responsible Party Identification
ResponsiblePartyIdentification.definition: Unique identification of the party responsible for the maintenance of the party reference data.
